title: File:Chest X-ray in influenza and Haemophilus influenzae, lateral.jpg
author:
Mikael Häggström ,  M.D.   Author info   -  Reusing images  - Conflicts of interest:   None  
 Mikael Häggström ,  M.D.   Consent note : Written informed consent was obtained from the individual, including online publication.
description:
edit   
AP  chest X-ray  of a 76 year old woman, who developed cough and labored breathing. First testing showed   influenza B virus  , and later a  nasopharyngeal swab  detected   Haemophilus influenzae  . The  H influenzae  presumably developed as an  opportunistic infection  secondary to the flu. This X-ray was taken 2 weeks after cultures and start of antibiotics, showing delayed pneumonic infiltrates that were only vaguely visible on initial (not shown) X-rays.
